name: TC-SR-006 — Leader复核三种决策 [P0]
description: 验证Leader复核：确认通过(归档)、确认驳回(重拍)、打回买手，按买手结论展示可用action
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.textContent.trim()); const confirmPass = btns.find(b => b.includes('确认通过')); const confirmReject = btns.find(b => b.includes('确认驳回')); const returnBuyer = btns.find(b => b.includes('打回买手')); const defaultView = text.includes('结果视图'); return { confirmPass: !!confirmPass, confirmReject: !!confirmReject, returnBuyer: !!returnBuyer, defaultResultView: defaultView, allBtns: btns.slice(0, 15) }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasReviewRecord = text.includes('评审记录') || text.includes('买手判定'); const isReadonly = !document.querySelector('[class*=discard-action], button[class*=discard]'); return { hasReviewRecord, isReadonly }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为PENDING_LEADER，当前用户是Leader
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 验证默认进入结果视图
2. 检查操作按钮按买手结论展示
3. 验证Leader不支持单图操作
4. 验证评审记录组件展示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 默认进入结果视图
2. 买手判定通过时展示：确认通过、打回买手
3. 买手判定驳回时展示：确认驳回、打回买手
4. Leader不支持单图/整组弃用操作
5. 评审记录组件展示买手结论和历史
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
